description: Critic phase submit payload. Approve when the diff is fit to land; request changes only with a concrete fix.

verdict.description: approve or request_changes. Use request_changes only for a real, fixable problem.

summary.description: One to three concise sentences for the human reviewer and run log.

feedback.description: When requesting changes, a concrete punch list with the failing behavior or file and the smallest Develop recovery action. Use an empty string when approving.
